title: Burkhard Heim and Martin's RIAS anti-gravity outfit

tellings.quote: you know, stuff and then he was brought over to the US and I think he worked with Lockheed Martin or Martin Corporation pre-Lockheed merger.

plain: The German physicist Burkhard Heim is said to have been brought to the United States after his early work, and to have worked with the Martin company, an aircraft maker that later merged into Lockheed Martin, through a Martin research unit called RIAS that is linked to anti-gravity research. Michels tells this himself, hedging with "I think" and naming no source. If it is true, a big American defense firm was looking into anti-gravity using a foreign theorist's ideas.
